Subject: New inbound: Neptune Labs (developer quickstart) — routing to ENG for tech demo

Hi Markus / Ava,

Inbound lead from the docs quickstart CTA — dev intent flagged. Short summary: Neptune Labs is evaluating low-latency on-prem inference for annotation tooling. Contact is Sara Kim (sara@neptunelabs.ai). They completed the quickstart and asked for a technical run-through around model routing, latency budgets, and private deployment options.

Key details:
- Company: Neptune Labs (seed-stage, 40 engineers)
- Use case: on-prem inference for annotation pipelines, 200 QPS bursts, latency target ~50ms p50
- Interested in: Dedicated vs Private, KV caching, autoscaling patterns
- Calendly link they used: https://calendly.com/neptunelabs/redwood-demo-30

Can you take the technical demo? Markus — would appreciate a 30–45m slot where you can show routing policies, batching, and the private deployment options. I attached the intake form we collected.

[Attachment: lead-intake.json] (lead details, timezone PST)

Thanks — I’ll leave it to you to reach out to Sara directly and propose times.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0118

Subject: Re: Intro: Neptune Labs — developer quickstart routed for technical demo

Hi Sara — great to meet you (virtually). I’m Markus, Solutions Engineer on the Open Inference team at Redwood. Thanks for trying the quickstart. Happy to run a technical session to cover: architecture options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), routing policies, batching strategies, and an integration sketch for your annotation pipeline.

Available times (PST):
- Mon Dec 11, 10:00–10:45am
- Mon Dec 11, 2:00–2:45pm
- Tue Dec 12, 9:30–10:15am

If none of those work, drop a couple windows that suit you and I’ll adjust. I’ve attached a very short integration outline to frame the conversation. Expect a 30–45 minute technical demo with a few minutes for Q&A.

Attachments:
- MVP-integration-outline.pdf (1 page)

High-level agenda:
1) Quick intake (your goals & constraints)
2) Runtime architecture & routing options
3) Live walkthrough: demo sandbox (model routing + KV caching)
4) Next steps & procurement touchpoints

Looking forward to it — I’m copying Ava (our solutions coordinator) to help lock the slot and create the calendar invite.

Best,
Markus Klein
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
